query: Hi, I bought this phone that came bundled with a limited-edition custom phone charm last month, and now I can’t use my mobile data at all while I’m traveling abroad — can you help me figure out what’s going wrong? I already checked and saw airplane mode is on, my network preference is set incorrectly, my APN MMS settings are broken, data mode is toggled off, my SIM card feels like it’s not seated right, and I have roaming turned off right now.
